when: Impact numbers, KPIs.

name: blog-feed
title: Blog / News Feed
description: A dynamic blog module listing the site's recent posts.
when: News, journal, resources. It lists the site's own published posts, so it needs posts: a site with none shows an empty feed.

name: icon-values
title: Icon Values Row
description: A row of icon + heading + text value blocks.
when: Core values, principles, benefits.

name: shop-grid
title: WooCommerce Products Grid
description: A product-listing section: a short heading/intro above the WooCommerce Shop module (divi/shop), which renders the store's products in a grid. Requires WooCommerce active on the buyer's site.
when: Use for a shop / product-listing / catalog section that displays WooCommerce products. It needs WooCommerce active and products in the shop: without them the product area stays empty.

name: hero-pattern-centered
title: Hero / centered type on a pattern
description: Centered, type-led hero: a huge display headline, one short sentence and one button over a fine repeating pattern on the page colour.
when: Top of a page when the message is strong enough to carry the first screen without a picture (studios, consultants, launches).

name: hero-split-right
title: Hero / split, tall image right
description: Asymmetric split hero: eyebrow, large headline, two lines of copy, a button and a quiet text link on a wide left column (two thirds); one tall portrait image on the right (one third).
when: Top of a page for a service, studio or practice with one strong photograph; the classic editorial first screen.

name: hero-split-left-overlap
title: Hero / image left, overlapping card
description: Split hero: a large rounded image on the left and, on the right, a raised surface card holding eyebrow, headline, copy and button that slides over the image edge (on phones it overlaps the bottom of the image instead).
when: Top of a page for warm, friendly or product brands that want depth on the first screen; needs one strong image.

name: hero-image-scrim
title: Hero / full-bleed photo with a scrim
description: Tall full-bleed photograph (about 80% of the screen height) under a scrim in the overlay colour, with eyebrow, headline, copy, two buttons and a ruled strip of three short practical details, left-aligned in the inverse text colour.
when: Top of a page when one atmospheric photograph sells the experience (hospitality, travel, events, upscale brands).

name: hero-gradient-stats
title: Hero / gradient with floating figures
description: Split hero on a soft gradient from the page colour to the surface colour: headline, copy and button on the left; three small tilted surface cards with placeholder figures stacked and overlapping on the right (straight and spaced on phones).
when: Top of a page for a product or service that can back its promise with real figures; the figures are placeholders the owner replaces with numbers they can prove, or the cards are removed.

name: hero-editorial-minimal
title: Hero / editorial headline
description: Minimal, left-aligned editorial hero: a small uppercase kicker, a very large display headline and a thin rule, then a short paragraph on the left and an underlined text link on the right (stacked on phones), with generous whitespace and no image or button.
when: Top of a page for writers, studios, firms and journals whose voice is the product; pairs best with a serif display font.

name: hero-bordered-cells
title: Hero / bold panel and three cells
description: Loud, left-aligned stacked hero: a huge uppercase headline inside a heavy-bordered panel, a grid of three bordered cells under it (an index label and one line each; one column on phones), then one bordered button.
when: Top of a page for bold, raw or flat brands (agencies, events, products with attitude) that say three things fast; works with heavy borders and square corners.

name: hero-spec-card
title: Hero / split with a ruled spec card
description: Left-aligned split hero: a small monospace-style version label, a tight headline, two lines of copy and a solid plus a bordered button on the left; a hairline-bordered card of ruled label/value lines on the right.
when: Top of a page for software, tools, developer products or technical services; the label and every value in the card are placeholders the owner replaces with real facts, or removes.

name: hero-product-glow
title: Hero / product shot with a glow
description: Centered product hero: eyebrow, headline, one sentence and two buttons over a soft radial glow, then a wide framed product picture with rounded corners and a row of three short placeholder trust lines under it.
when: Top of a page for a software product or app with a screenshot to show; the screenshot and every trust line are placeholders the owner replaces (never invented customers, ratings or figures).

name: header-title-band
title: Page header / title band
description: Compact inner-page title band on the surface colour: a breadcrumb-style kicker line and the page title in a wide left column, a short summary in a narrow right column (under the title on phones), closed by a hairline along the bottom edge.
when: Top of an inner page (services, about, contact, legal) where the visitor needs to know where they are, not to be sold to again.

name: header-divider-intro
title: Page header / inverted band with a curve
description: Centered inner-page header on a band in the text colour (dark on light designs, light on dark ones): kicker, page title, a short rule and a short intro in the page colour, ending in a curved section divider that flows into the page colour below.
when: Top of an inner page that deserves a moment of emphasis (a service, a programme, a campaign page); follow it with a section on the page colour so the curve joins it.

name: header-image-band
title: Page header / photo band
description: Inner-page header on a photograph under a scrim in the overlay colour, shorter than a hero: breadcrumb-style kicker, page title and one line, left-aligned in the inverse text colour.
when: Top of an inner page that should keep the site's photographic mood (a location, a project, a service area); needs one landscape image.

name: features-bento
title: Features / bento grid of unequal tiles
description: Bento grid of five square-cornered, hairline-bordered tiles in two rows of unequal spans: a large picture tile (two thirds) beside two stacked tiles (one on the accent colour), then a narrow inverted tile beside a wide one; above them a split intro (heading left, line and link right); one column on phones.
when: Benefits or features of a software product, studio or tool with one lead feature and four smaller ones; flat, technical or raw brands. Needs one picture.

name: features-zigzag
title: Features / zigzag image and text rows
description: Three alternating rows under a centred intro: a square-cornered 4:3 picture on one side and a numbered kicker, heading, two lines and a text link on the other, the picture switching sides on every row; on phones each row stacks with the picture first.
when: Feature or service detail when each point deserves its own picture (services, products, studios); calm, editorial and upscale brands. Needs three pictures.

name: list-icon-dividers
title: Features / icon list with dividers
description: A single centred column of five feature rows separated by hairline rules, each row an icon on the left and a short heading with one muted line on the right, under a left-aligned intro; reads like a specification list.
when: Benefits or included features when there are five or more short points and no pictures (software, services, memberships); plain, technical and editorial brands.

name: checklist-two-column
title: Features / two-column checklist
description: A narrow left column with the heading and intro beside a two-column checklist of eight short items, each a plain tick icon beside one line, on the surface colour; one column on phones.
when: What is included in a service, package or membership, or a list of requirements met; every kind of brand. Keep each item to one line.

name: steps-numbered
title: Process / numbered steps
description: Three steps set as a ruled list: a short intro on a narrow left column, then on the right a stack of three steps, each a very large numeral (01, 02, 03) over a heading and one line, with a hairline between steps; one column on phones.
when: How it works for a service or product with a simple three-step process (booking, onboarding, ordering); suits plain, editorial and technical brands.

name: steps-horizontal
title: Process / horizontal steps joined by a line
description: Four steps side by side under a centred intro, each a round numbered marker in the accent colour joined to the next by a horizontal rule, then a short heading and one line; two per row on tablets, one column without the rules on phones, and one button under the steps.
when: How it works for a service with four clear stages (consultation, plan, delivery, follow-up); friendly and modern brands that like round shapes.

name: timeline-vertical
title: Process / vertical timeline
description: One-sided vertical timeline: a short intro on a narrow left column and, on the right, four entries hung on a thin vertical rule with a small square marker each, every entry a small step or date label, a heading and one line; on phones the intro sits above the timeline.
when: How it works, a project plan or a short history in order (milestones, phases, a programme schedule); calm, technical or editorial brands. The labels are placeholders the owner replaces (never invented dates).

name: features-accordion-image
title: Features / accordion beside a picture
description: Two-column feature block: an eyebrow, heading and a ruled accordion of four short feature items (no boxes, a hairline under each, the first open) on the left, one tall square-cornered 4:5 picture on the right; on phones the picture sits under the accordion.
when: Feature detail when each point needs a few sentences but the page must stay short (services, products, programmes); calm, editorial, technical and flat brands. Needs one picture.

name: compare-two-panels
title: Features / before and after panels
description: Old way versus new way: a left-aligned heading over two square-cornered panels side by side, a plain hairline-bordered panel with four crossed-out points on the left and an inverted panel in the text colour with four ticked points and a button on the right; stacked on phones.
when: Problem and solution, before and after, or doing it yourself versus with you (services, software, coaching); sharp, technical and upscale brands. Compare situations, never named competitors.

name: features-carousel-strip
title: Features / sliding feature strip
description: A left-aligned heading and line above a carousel strip of six feature items (a round accent icon badge, a heading and one line each), three visible at a time on desktops, two on tablets and one on phones, moved with the arrows at either side.
when: Benefits when there are more features than fit in one row (apps, services, memberships); friendly, rounded and dark-glass brands.

name: stats-big-numbers
title: Stats / big numbers on an inverted band
description: An inverted band in the text colour (dark on light designs, light on dark ones): a short heading, then three very large placeholder figures across the full width, each under a rule and over a one-line label (one column on phones).
when: Credibility after the benefits, only when the owner has three figures they can prove (years, projects, response time); every figure and label is a bracketed placeholder to replace or remove, never an invented statistic.
